observations.body: Gathering for a meal exposes divisions and humiliation. But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse. What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
